name: Slicer
description: Chop a loop into slices -- by its hits, into equal parts, or live on the pads -- and save it as a kit
changelog: 0.3.2: a root deleted before the app's teardown is handled (gui 2.0 calls destroy with none); requires core 2.0 and gui 2.0
0.3.1: license is now GPL-3.0-or-later; no code changes

0.3.0: ATK -- every slice's attack, 0 to 500 ms; PITCH -- the loop transposed -12..+12 semitones, varispeed (higher is faster); PLAY, the pads, FREE and KIT all hear both, and the kit is written with them (SliceMath::sliceGain / readPitched, the same code both ways); SAVE KIT is KIT; requires core 1.31; a value being turned reads dark on the accent: the text colour sits on the button, which is the only thing ever EDITED, not on its label
0.2.1: FREE: a lit pad plays from its cut instead of cutting again; a dark pad cuts
0.2.0: FILES browses the whole card a folder at a time (paged), not only the recordings; requires core 1.27
